project_description: Chinese case-control cohort of 35 clinically diagnosed gout patients vs 33 healthy controls; fecal samples; 16S rRNA V1-V3 pyrosequencing plus whole-metagenome shotgun sequencing.
citation: Guo et al. 2016, Sci Rep, PMID 26852926
notes: Species-level finding from metagenomic species (MGS) analysis of shotgun data; abstract states verbatim: 'In gout, Bacteroides caccae and Bacteroides xylanisolvens are enriched yet Faecalibacterium prausnitzii and Bifidobacterium pseudocatenulatum depleted.' Wilcoxon rank-sum test; no exact p-value or FDR-corrected q-value stated for these taxa. Gout diagnosed by endocrinologists from blood uric acid plus joint pain; urate-lowering therapy status and acute vs intercritical disease state not reported.

project_description: Chinese case-control cohort of 26 male gout patients vs 26 male healthy controls; fecal samples; 16S rRNA V3-V4 Illumina MiSeq sequencing with LEfSe.
citation: Shao et al. 2017, Front Microbiol, PMID 28270806
notes: Male-only cohort; all patients had gout for >=12 months and received no medical treatment within 1 month before sampling (i.e. off urate-lowering therapy); disease state acute vs intercritical not specified. LEfSe run at a deliberately lenient threshold (LDA score >2); per-taxon LDA scores and p-values are not stated in the text (figure only), and no FDR correction is reported for the taxa. Genus-level direction taken from the Discussion: 'Our study also finds the family Bacteroidaceae sp. and its genera Bacteroides enriching in male gout patients.'

project_description: Mexican case-control cohort of 58 ACR/EULAR-diagnosed gout patients (33 with subcutaneous tophi, 25 without) vs 53 healthy controls; fecal samples; 16S rRNA V3-V4 Illumina MiSeq.
citation: Mendez-Salazar et al. 2021, Mol Med, PMID 34030623
notes: Gout diagnosed by 2015 ACR/EULAR criteria; patients on long-term urate-lowering therapy (Discussion refers to more than 8 years of allopurinol treatment); recent antibiotic users and patients with diabetes/CKD excluded; BMI, glucose and triglycerides were significantly higher in gout groups than controls (residual confounding possible). Differential taxa were called by Kruskal-Wallis followed by Wilcoxon with a fold-change cut-off of >=1.5; FDR correction was applied to alpha-diversity indices only, not reported for these taxa. Exact effect sizes not stated in text. Abstract: higher abundance in patients with gout WITHOUT tophi when compared to controls; Discussion adds 'Phascolarctobacterium and Bacteroides were the most enriched genera in both gout groups.'
